title: FIFA 21
description: FIFA 21 is a football simulation game featuring updated rosters, improved gameplay mechanics, and new career mode features. It includes Ultimate Team, Volta Football, and Pro Clubs modes.

title: God of War Ragnarok
description: God of War Ragnarok continues the Norse saga of Kratos and Atreus as they prepare for the prophesied end of the world. Features expanded combat, new realms, and a deeper story.

title: Pokémon Red
description: Pokémon Red is one of the original Pokémon games where players explore the Kanto region, capture Pokémon, defeat eight gym leaders, and challenge the Elite Four.

title: The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild
description: An open-world adventure where Link explores Hyrule, climbs mountains, glides through the air, and battles Calamity Ganon. Features physics-based gameplay and a massive open world.

title: Red Dead Redemption 2
description: An epic tale of life in America's unforgiving heartland. The game's vast and atmospheric world also provides the foundation for a brand new online multiplayer experience.

title: Cyberpunk 2077
description: An open-world action-adventure story set in Night City, a megalopolis obsessed with power, glamour and body modification. Players take the role of V, a mercenary outlaw going after a one-of-a-kind implant.

title: Halo Infinite
description: Master Chief returns in Halo Infinite, featuring an open-world campaign on the Zeta Halo ring and a free-to-play multiplayer mode. The game introduces the grappleshot mechanic.

title: Elden Ring
description: Elden Ring is an action RPG set in the Lands Between, created by FromSoftware and written by George R.R. Martin. Features open-world exploration, challenging combat, and deep lore.

title: Animal Crossing: New Horizons
description: Escape to a deserted island and create your own paradise in Animal Crossing: New Horizons. Collect resources, craft items, and build a thriving community of adorable animal villagers.

title: Grand Theft Auto V
description: Set in the fictional state of San Andreas, GTA V follows three criminals and their efforts to commit heists while under pressure from a government agency. Features an expansive open world and GTA Online.
